lorwyn-expert.summary: Raised in, or devoted to studying, the sunlit land of Lorwyn: honours the great creature Eirdu as the sun made flesh, craves whimsical adventure and clings to loved ones, having watched others drift into Shadowmoor and come back diminished.

shadowmoor-expert.summary: Raised in, or long a scholar of, moonlit Shadowmoor, where wits or brawn keep you alive and trust is scarce: you know that choosing whom to rely on can decide whether you live.
